title: Stop payment fraud and rank your security risks

say: Stop payment fraud and rank your security risks.
This is the video for module 1 of Cybersecurity Fundamentals.
Small businesses, schools, churches and NGOs are mostly hurt by four ordinary attacks. First, account takeover, usually through a reused password or a fake login page.

panel.heading: Four ordinary attacks cause most harm

say: Second, business email compromise, where a real or lookalike email asks for a payment or a change of bank details.

panel.heading: Four ordinary attacks cause most harm

say: Third, ransomware and other malware, often from a pirated program, a fake update or an attachment.

panel.heading: Four ordinary attacks cause most harm

say: Fourth, lost, stolen or shared devices and passwords.
None needs a genius attacker. Each uses a habit or a missing control, and those you can change.

panel.heading: Four ordinary attacks cause most harm

say: Security professionals use one simple model, the CIA triad. Nothing to do with spies.
C is confidentiality: only the right people can see the information.

cards.d: Only the right people can see it. Example: a laptop with the members' list is stolen.
Information is correct. Example: a fraudster edits the bank details on an invoice.
Systems work when needed. Example: ransomware locks every file before a report is due.

say: I is integrity: the information is correct and has not been changed by the wrong person.

cards.d: Only the right people can see it. Example: a laptop with the members' list is stolen.
Information is correct. Example: a fraudster edits the bank details on an invoice.
Systems work when needed. Example: ransomware locks every file before a report is due.

say: A is availability: systems work when people need them.
Every incident damages at least one of these, and naming it helps you choose the fix.

say: For example, Funmi is finance officer for a small NGO in Abuja. An email from Musa at Brightline Printers says the bank has changed, and an invoice of 2,450,000 naira must go to a new account today.
She looks past the display name to the real address.

Call a number from the original contract

say: The address has a hyphen and a different ending from past invoices. It is a lookalike domain. In Show original, SPF and DKIM pass, but only for the attacker's own domain.

say: Here is the rule that defeats most payment fraud. Keep a supplier list with bank details and phone numbers collected at onboarding.

panel.heading: A payment rule that works
items: Keep a supplier list with bank details and phones
Treat any bank-detail change as suspicious
Call a number already on file
Wait one working day on a changed account
Record who called and who confirmed

say: Treat any request to change bank details, by any channel, as suspicious until verified.

panel.heading: A payment rule that works
items: Keep a supplier list with bank details and phones
Treat any bank-detail change as suspicious
Call a number already on file
Wait one working day on a changed account
Record who called and who confirmed

say: Verify by calling a number already on file, never one given in the request. Remember, if a real mailbox is hacked, all the checks will pass. Only the call-back catches it.

say: Wait a cooling-off period, for example one working day, before a first payment to a changed account. And record the check: date, who called, who confirmed.
If money has already gone, call your bank's fraud line at once.

say: A risk is an asset you care about, a threat to it, and a weakness that lets the threat succeed. List your assets, then name the threat and weakness for each.

panel.heading: Score each risk from 1 to 25
items: Name a threat and the weakness
8 to 14 medium: plan with a date

say: Score likelihood from 1 to 5, and impact from 1 to 5. Multiply them for a score from 1 to 25.

panel.heading: Score each risk from 1 to 25
items: Name a threat and the weakness
8 to 14 medium: plan with a date

say: Scores of 15 to 25 need action now. 8 to 14 need a plan with a date. 1 to 7 can be accepted and reviewed.

For example, Amaka scores her cooperative's main email, with a reused password and no second factor, at 4 times 5, which is 20. Supplier payments with no call-back rule score 15. So email comes first, payments second.

panel.rule: Sort by score. Fix the highest first.

say: In Nigeria, the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 makes security a legal duty, and the NDPC is the regulator.
Tell people what you collect and why. Collect only what you need. If you do not need someone's NIN, do not collect it.
Delete what you no longer need and protect the rest. A breach that puts people at risk must be reported to the NDPC within 72 hours.
This is a working guide, not legal advice.

panel.heading: Your duties under the NDPA 2023
items: Tell people what you collect and why
Delete data you no longer need

say: To remember. Name which part of the CIA triad was damaged. Check the real From and Reply-To addresses.
Before any bank change, call back on a number on file. Rank your work by likelihood times impact. And data you never collected cannot leak.

say: Your tasks: classify three incidents you know, check two email headers with Show original, write a payment verification rule, and build a risk register with at least six scored risks. Save each in your audit document.
